value.syntax: # [doc = " Failure publishing a check result through [`finish_check_command`]."] # [derive (Debug , thiserror :: Error)] pub enum CheckResultError { # [doc = " Direct mode refused because stdout is a terminal (exit class 2)."] # [error ("stdout is a terminal; refusing to write result data")] TtyRefusal , # [doc = " Exactly one of `--report`/`--stamp` was supplied. `clap` normally"] # [doc = " prevents this; the variant keeps the finalizer total."] # [error ("invalid checker output mode: --report and --stamp are all-or-nothing")] InvalidMode , # [doc = " The report could not be published or the stamp could not be"] # [doc = " touched."] # [error ("failed to publish the check result")] Io (# [from] io :: Error) , # [doc = " Build mode named one destination for both the report and the"] # [doc = " stamp; a stamp holding JSON bytes would contradict its"] # [doc = " empty-stamp role."] # [error ("aliased checker outputs: {0}")] AliasedOutputs (# [from] AliasedOutputs) , }
